title: VUA EAC termination receipt v0.1
description: Receipt document for proposal 006 R1b — the termination step (R6: every termination is one plan step: evidence snapshot before, re-check after, failures reported as failures). kind=terminated: the four-element re-verification (name/path/signature/pid liveness) passed, the process was terminated, its exit was awaited, and the post-state re-check confirms it is gone. kind=refused: the re-verification refused (R3 — any element that cannot be verified refuses); nothing was opened with termination rights. kind=failed: the re-verification passed but the termination could not be completed (open/wait/timeout) — the half-state surfaces inspect_required to the task face (R6/R4: no retry, no implicit resume). The pre-state evidence snapshot (the full eac-probe snapshot taken before the step) travels beside this receipt. Termination is always the last-resort, individually confirmed plan step; the allowlist starts empty and grows only from real-machine evidence (R2).

verified.description: True only when the R3 four-element re-verification returned Verified (name + path + signature + pid liveness).

preCheck.description: The R4 guard re-checked inside the step: an active VRChat session refuses the termination (from-wide).

inspectRequired.description: R6: a failed termination is never retried implicitly — the half-state waits for an explicit decision.
